editorial:
Imagine having to team up with your ex just to prove you hated each other. That is exactly the mess Marguerite finds herself in. She is already moved on with a new partner and a cute kid, but she needs the church to cancel her old marriage to Fred. To get that annulment, the two of them have to sit down and dig through all their old fights and failed moments. It sounds like a nightmare, but it actually turns into a really sweet and funny ride. You get to see how two people who thought they knew everything about their breakup start remembering things a bit differently.

The acting is the best part here because the chemistry between the leads feels totally real. Some parts of the story drag a little when they get too deep into the sadness, but the jokes keep you moving. If you like movies that make you laugh and cry at the same time, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call.
endingExplained: In the end, Marguerite and Fred realize that while they were not right for each other as a couple, they still care about each other as people. After proving their marriage was a mistake to the church, they don't get back together. Instead, they find a healthy way to be friends. They both walk away feeling free and happy, finally closing the door on their past without any hate left between them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about second chances and messy relationships.
